claims.text: Exactly four fixed plan indices have one retained native generate attempt each, including censored and failed outcomes.

Where an F6WidePairIndex m4 cell completes, its saved signed finite-domain pair table is hash checked; any positive point-decomposition witness is independently group-replayed. A no-decomposition outcome is not separately certified exhaustive by the current native verifier. This adapter is not a general Groebner F6 solver.
A BSGS cell is labelled solved ECDLP only when its independently recovered scalar and known-answer identity pass native verify for the public generator and target.
Each attempted shard retains native verify, report and strict export statuses, a restricted archive and fresh S3 byte-equality receipts for archive and custody pointer; failed stages remain counted.
No F6-versus-BSGS speed, general Groebner F6, whole-worker instruction, exact fall-degree, ECDLP advantage or broader matrix claim is inferred.

Custody requires restricted S3 archive and pointer PUT plus fresh GET byte comparison. Retain failures, timeouts and missing stages.
